protocol.split: 70% train / 30% held out, stratified per seed
protocol.sequence: digit cue with non-label event marker -> independent real-digit distractors -> exactly zero query
protocol.causal_order: use theta_t gate and predict first; submit current event target afterward; submit digit class only after zero-query prediction
protocol.trainable_scope: frozen reservoir/injection; online readout plus an independent auxiliary-event gate update
protocol.evaluation: held-out streams with readout and gate updates disabled
protocol.matching: seed/data/order/distractors/corruption uniforms and multiscale initial parameters are paired
protocol.gate_semantics: external gates override state writes while the learned controller may train in the background; learned conditions use its continuous gate and the controller sees only the one-dimensional event marker
limitations: the event label is immediate auxiliary supervision, not delayed reward
the cue marker explicitly exposes event type but never digit class
three seeds are a mechanism screen rather than confirmatory evidence
Digits fading memory is not language learning, Go strength, or animal learning
